vi_current.back_flavor: Bạn không còn nhớ rõ khuôn mặt của những người thân yêu. Bạn bắt đầu suy nghĩ và cảm nhận như một sinh vật Yithian thực thụ.

en.name: Humanity Fading
en.text: Each investigator's maximum hand size is reduced by 4.
en.flavor:
How long has it been? Days? Weeks?

…Years?
en.back_text: Each surviving investigator is defeated.
en.back_flavor: You forget all that you once were. Your name, and your humanity, are lost. However, the lost city of Pnakotus calls to you, its peaceful halls a treasure trove of knowledge more vast than anything your mind could have comprehended before your arrival here. Your purpose lost in the haze, you live out your days with the Great Race of Yith, until one day...

vi_current.name: Nhân Tính Lụi Tàn
vi_current.text: Kích thước bàn tay tối đa của mỗi điều tra viên giảm đi 4.
vi_current.flavor: Thời gian sắp hết. Nếu không hành động ngay, bạn sẽ vĩnh viễn bị mắc kẹt trong thân xác quái vật này tại quá khứ hàng triệu năm trước.
vi_current.back_text: Mỗi điều tra viên bị mắc kẹt vĩnh viễn trong thân xác Yithian. (→R3)
vi_current.back_flavor: Ý thức con người của bạn hoàn toàn bị xóa sổ. Bạn trở thành một học giả Yithian vô cảm trong thư viện Pnakotus vĩnh hằng.

en.name: Exploring Pnakotus
en.text: Each copy of Yithian Observer gains aloof.
en.flavor: Getting out of this strange city might be harder than you thought. Its halls are endless and filled with all manner of complex, futuristic machinery.
en.back_text: Put each set-aside location into play (Great Library, Laboratory of the Great Race, Yithian Orrery, Deconstuction Room, and Towers of Pnakotus). Choose one of those locations at random. Put the set-aside The Custodian asset into play at the randomly chosen location. (Note: Each copy of Yithian Observer is no longer aloof.)
en.back_flavor: You explore the area near your interview chamber for some time, learning more of this city and its dwellers. It is a place of knowledge and research, inhabited by beings who call themselves the Great Race of Yith. For the most part, the Yithians allow you to explore the city without troubling you, though some of them follow you about and observe you with keen interest. As you pass through one of the city's meandering halls, you find a panel attached to the wall. It is a technological device you cannot hope to understand. As you stand in front of it, dumbfounded, one of your observers approaches cautiously. It extends one of its claw-appendages and manipulates the panel in a convoluted manner. To your surprise, the wall in front of you slides open to reveal another series of halls. The creature steps aside to let you pass.

vi_current.name: Khám Phá Pnakotus
vi_current.text: Objective — Thích nghi với cơ thể mới và tìm đường tới khu vực lưu trữ hồ sơ tâm trí.
vi_current.flavor: Thân xác nón khổng lồ vụng về và kỳ dị, nhưng bạn phải học cách điều khiển nó để sinh tồn.
vi_current.back_flavor: Bạn tìm thấy bản đồ của khu lưu trữ trung tâm, nơi cất giữ cỗ máy hoán chuyển linh hồn.

en.name: Restricted Access
en.text: Objective - If three of the following are true, you must advance: - An investigator "found the process." - An investigator "dissected an organ." - An investigator "interviewed a subject." - An investigator "realized what year it is." - An investigator "activated the device." - An investigator controls The Custodian.
en.flavor: You have to find a way back home. Surely if the Yithians can bring you to this place, there must be a way to return…
en.back_text: You no longer have to perform any of the following tasks. However, the more you have performed by the time the scenario ends, the easier the transition to your human body will be, and the less likely the process is to fail or backfire. Be careful... Place this act in the victory display with this side faceup, as a reminder. - An investigator "found the process." - An investigator "dissected an organ." - An investigator "interviewed a subject." - An investigator "realized what year it is." - An investigator "activated the device." - An investigator controls The Custodian.
en.back_flavor: You believe you have discovered the process used by the Yithians to transport you here. But the truth is hard to accept. Your body was never brought to this place. Your mind has been transferred into the body of one of these creatures. Somewhere, in another place - in another time - one of the reviled creatures dwells in your body.

vi_current.name: Khu Vực Hạn Chế
vi_current.text: Objective — Vượt qua hệ thống an ninh và lính gác Yithian để lấy lại hồ sơ cơ thể người của bạn.
vi_current.flavor: Những lính gác Yithian cầm súng điện từ tuần tra khắp các dãy hành lang kim loại khổng lồ.
vi_current.back_flavor: Bạn tìm thấy ống chứa lưu trữ mẫu sóng não và định vị được vị trí thân xác con người của mình!

en.name: Repossession
en.text: Each Yithian Observer gains hunter. [action] Spend 1 clue: Draw. Draw 2 cards instead of 1. If your hand exceeds your maximum hand size, draw 1 additional card. Objective - If each surviving investigator has 10 or more cards in his or her hand, immediately advance. (Beware - remember to complete as many of the tasks listed on act 2b as you can.)
en.flavor: You have gathered the knowledge necessary to repossess your body, but before you can initiate the process, you must expand your mind.
en.back_flavor:
The machine whirs with intense vibration. It has taken many hours to construct, and you have had to build it in secret, using the knowledge you have gathered from the various areas within the city. It is a strange device of rods, wheels, and glass, about the size of a small filing cabinet. A circular mirror in the center sends your alien reflection staring back at you.
You activate the device, and you feel a tugging on your psyche, stretching your consciousness across the aether of space and time. The memories come flooding back.

vi_current.name: Tái Chiếm Thân Xác
vi_current.text: Objective — Kích hoạt cỗ máy hoán đổi tâm trí và đưa ý thức của cả nhóm trở lại thân xác con người. [action]: Resign. Bạn kéo cần gạt cỗ máy.
vi_current.flavor: Cỗ máy hoán chuyển linh hồn đang ở ngay trước mắt. Hãy khởi động nó để trở về thế giới thực tại!
vi_current.back_flavor: Một luồng điện cực mạnh chạy dọc thần kinh! Bạn mở mắt và hít một hơi thở dài bằng phổi của con người. Bạn đã trở lại thân xác của chính mình!

en.name: The Descent Begins
en.flavor: Slowly and cautiously, you begin your descent into the red-litten caverns of Yoth. It is quiet, and only the crumbling of stone and your echoing footfalls can be heard in the tunnels surrounding you.
en.back_text: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it in the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
en.back_flavor: The serpents' ruins are ancient, decrepit, and devoid of life. Nearly all of their structures have collapsed, but evidence of their great cities remains, along with statues and idols of their gods. This realm must have been abandoned long ago.

vi_current.name: Cuộc Hạ Xuống Bắt Đầu
vi_current.flavor: Bạn đặt chân xuống Yoth — tầng sâu đỏ rực của thế giới ngầm, lãnh địa của loài người rắn cổ xưa. Hơi nóng hầm hập và mùi lưu huỳnh bốc lên ngột ngạt.
vi_current.back_text: Hạ xuống tầng sâu tiếp theo của Yoth. Đặt 1 doom lên agenda mới.
vi_current.back_flavor: Mỗi bước đi xuống sâu hơn khiến không khí càng thêm nóng rát và nguy hiểm.

en.name: Horrific Descent
en.flavor: Hisses begin to emanate from the tunnels all around you. Snake eyes glare at you from the dark as you attempt to avoid encountering the creatures that remain in this realm. You weave in and out of narrow tunnels and hide behind broken‑down walls and crumbling pillars.
en.back_text: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level. Check your supplies. If an investigator has a canteen, that investigator must decide: - This could be useful. Remember that you have "collected a strange liquid." - I'm not going anywhere near that.You suffer no ill effects.
en.back_flavor: You pass through a cracked earthen clearing that once might have been a plaza. Standing half-collapsed in the center of the plaza are the remains of a stone fountain, dry as a bone. At the very bottom of the fountain's basin is a glob of black syrupy ooze.

vi_current.name: Hạ Xuống Kinh Hoàng
vi_current.flavor: Những tiếng thì thầm rít lên trong bóng tối. Lũ người rắn đang tổ chức bao vây.
vi_current.back_text: Hạ xuống tầng sâu tiếp theo của Yoth.
vi_current.back_flavor: Bóng tối đỏ rực như máu nuốt trọn lấy những kẻ dấn bước.

en.name: Endless Caverns
en.flavor: You are convinced of it now: these caverns are without end. They must span the entirety of the subterranean layer of the Earth. Will you ever reach the Nexus? Will you ever make it home?
en.back_text:
Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
The lead investigator chooses one investigator to be the group's scout. That investigator checks his or her supplies.
If the scout has rope, he or she is able to climb up with ease, and the investigators suffer no ill effects. 
If the scout does not have rope, he or she must test [combat] or [agility] (5). If the performing investigator fails, he or she makes it to the top but suffers 1 physical trauma from the exhaustion of the climb.
en.back_flavor: The path ahead is blocked by a sheer rock cliff. You start to search for a way around when suddenly, hisses and shrieks emerge from behind you, and the area is bathed in orange fire-light. The serpents are coming - one of you must climb to safety and pull the others up!

vi_current.name: Những Hang Động Bất Tận
vi_current.flavor: Mê cung hang động dường như kéo dài vô tận vào tâm Trái Đất.
vi_current.back_text: Hạ xuống tầng sâu tiếp theo của Yoth.
vi_current.back_flavor: Đá nóng chảy bắt đầu rỉ ra từ các khe nứt trên vách hang.

en.name: City of Blood
en.flavor: The caverns are no longer quiet. The angry cries and rattling of serpent creatures is all around you now, urging you onward. The cavern’s unnatural red glow becomes more intense. In this red light, the cities of Yoth take on another guise - no longer a source of hidden knowledge, but a place of animosity that resents your mere presence.
en.back_text:
If the Harbinger of Valusia is set aside, move it to the pursuit area.
Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
en.back_flavor: The shrill noise of hundreds of snake rattles suddenly erupts throughout the cavern. You have crossed into territory that humanity was never meant to enter. The earsplitting alarm pierces your eardrums and causes your ears to bleed. Your senses are overwhelmed, and you cover your ears in vain. You cannot hear your own thoughts. Finally the warning ends, and you are left with the uncontrollable urge to flee. However, you know that if you fled now, your actions would endanger all of humanity. Bravely - or perhaps foolishly - you press onward.

vi_current.name: Thành Phố Máu
vi_current.flavor: Bạn tiến vào phế tích thành phố ngầm của người rắn. Nham thạch sôi sục thắp sáng những đền thờ cổ.
vi_current.back_text: Hạ xuống tầng sâu tiếp theo của Yoth.
vi_current.back_flavor: Cơn thịnh nộ của Yig ngày càng nặng nề bao trùm cả chiều sâu địa ngục.

en.name: Fury That Shakes the Earth
en.text: Forced - After the third doom is placed on this agenda: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
en.flavor: The serpents have stirred up something much larger and more deadly than anything you have faced on this journey. Pale, sweaty, and terrified, you scurry for an exit - any exit.
en.back_text:
Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
If Yig is set aside:
The ground shakes with each of the massive creature's steps. He crushes the stone beneath his mighty feet, tearing through walls with his clawed, scaly hands. He sets his hateful eyes on you, unhinging his jaw in a cruel display of hunger.
Spawn Yig in the location where the investigators began at this depth level.

vi_current.name: Cơn Thịnh Nộ Rung Chuyển Lòng Đất
vi_current.text: Forced - Sau khi doom thứ ba được đưa vào agenda này: Tìm kẻ địch đang theo đuổi với giá trị evade cao nhất và spawn nó tại địa điểm nơi các điều tra viên bắt đầu ở cấp độ sâu này.
vi_current.flavor: Mặt đất rung chuyển dữ dội! Yig — Cha Đẻ Của Loài Rắn — đã thức giấc!
vi_current.back_text: Hạ xuống tầng sâu tiếp theo của Yoth.
vi_current.back_flavor: Cả trần hang nứt toác và mưa đá nham thạch trút xuống đầu bạn.

en.name: The Red Depths
en.text: Forced - After any amount of doom is placed on this agenda: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
en.flavor: The deeper your descent, the brighter and more pervasive the red glow of the caverns becomes. If you didn’t know any better, you would think you were descending into the very depths of hell itself.
en.back_text: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it in the location where the investigators began at this depth level. Until the end of the scenario, the current agenda gains: "Forced - After any amount of doom is placed on the current agenda: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it in the location where the investigators began at this depth level." Place this card in the pursuit area with this side faceup, as a reminder.
en.back_flavor: Nothing can stop the denizens of Yoth. They emerge from hidden places all around you, hissing their foul curses. The caves are plunged into chaos as the serpents close in.

vi_current.name: Tầng Sâu Đỏ Rực
vi_current.text: Forced - Sau khi đưa bất kỳ lượng doom nào vào agenda này: Tìm kẻ địch đang theo đuổi với giá trị evade cao nhất và spawn tại địa điểm nơi các điều tra viên bắt đầu ở cấp độ sâu này.
vi_current.flavor: Nhiệt độ lên tới mức thiêu đốt. Bạn phải tìm thấy cánh cổng Nexus trước khi bị nung chảy!
vi_current.back_text: Hạ xuống tầng sâu tiếp theo của Yoth.
vi_current.back_flavor: Bóng hình khổng lồ đầy vảy của Yig lướt qua trong biển lửa.

en.name: VENGEANCE
en.text: Forced - At the end of the 'check doom threshold' step of the mythos phase: The investigators must draw 1 additional encounter card for each doom in play, in player order. Objective - If each investigator is defeated, advance this agenda.
en.flavor: You never should have come here.
en.back_flavor: The serpents chase you relentlessly through the tunnels and ruined cities of Yoth, giving you no quarter, no rest, no chance of escape. You cannot hope to hide from their uncanny senses, nor can you run for much longer. Desperate for any way to elude them - any way at all - you run to a nearby chasm. A lone narrow bridge spans the pit. Underneath is a bottomless black abyss that devours the red light of Yoth.

vi_current.name: BÁO THÙ
vi_current.text: Forced - Khi kết thúc bước 'kiểm tra ngưỡng doom' của giai đoạn Mythos: các điều tra viên phải rút thêm 1 lá bài chạm trán cho mỗi doom trong màn chơi, theo thứ tự điều tra viên. Objective - Nếu mỗi điều tra viên bị đánh bại, advance agenda này.
vi_current.flavor: Không còn đường lui! Yig trực tiếp giáng lâm để trừng phạt những kẻ xâm phạm!
vi_current.back_text: Mỗi điều tra viên bị nghiền nát dưới cơn thịnh nộ của Thần Rắn. (→R2)
vi_current.back_flavor: Yig nuốt chửng bạn vào biển lửa đỏ rực của cõi Yoth vĩnh hằng.

en.name: Journey to the Nexus
en.text: [action] If there are no clues on your location: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Objective - At the end of the round, if investigators at Steps of Yoth possess the requisite number of clues, they may advance. (Beware - any investigator who is not at Steps of Yoth will be defeated.)
en.flavor: Doubt and horror grew upon me as I wound still farther down the seemingly endless staircase. Would the thing never stop?- H. P. Lovecraft and Zealia Bishop, <u>The Mound</u>
en.back_text: Add 1 resource to the current depth level. If the current depth level is 5+ and you are playing in Campaign Mode, go to (→R2). Otherwise, perform the following: - Each investigator who is not at Steps of Yoth is left behind and is defeated. Each surviving investigator loses each of his or her clues. - Move each enemy in play to the pursuit area. - Remove all doom from locations in play. Set each location in play and in the exploration deck aside, out of play. Investigators are not defeated during this process. - Draw a random set-aside location other than Steps of Yoth, put it into play, and place each surviving investigator at that location. - Create a new exploration deck consisting of Steps of Yoth and 4 other random set-aside locations. Shuffle the exploration deck. - Flip this act back over. Journey as deep as you can…

vi_current.name: Hành Trình Tới Nexus
vi_current.text: Objective — Thám hiểm các tầng hang và tìm đường tới Nexus of N'kai. [action]: Resign. Bạn leo thang dây rút lui an toàn về tầng trên.
vi_current.flavor: Mục tiêu duy nhất của bạn là sống sót và hạ xuống tầng sâu nhất: Nexus.
vi_current.back_flavor: Bạn nhảy qua dòng nham thạch cuối cùng và chạm tới cánh cổng dẫn vào cõi tối thượng N'kai.

en.name: Threads of Time
en.text: Forced - If an investigator with the Relic of Ages in his or her hand, deck, discard pile, or play area is eliminated: Immediately advance to agenda 3b.
en.flavor: As you enter the grand chamber beyond the doorway, the Nexus stirs. The Earth quakes below you, and the wall chips and crumbles. Shards of stone float in midair above the Nexus. You are running out of time: Reality is starting to shatter all around you.
en.back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Spawn the set-aside Formless Spawn in the Nexus of N'kai. Place this card in the victory display. It gains Vengeance 1.
en.back_flavor: You are not the first to intrude in this abyssal pit. You were warned not to break the seal, and yet here you are. Now you face the consequences for your foolish transgression. The thing emerges from the lightless void beyond the Nexus. It is a being of black polymorphic ichor, an animated viscous ooze that crawls along the ground with shapeless limbs and leaves a trail of smooth, dissolved stone in its wake.

vi_current.name: Những Sợi Tơ Thời Gian
vi_current.text: Forced - Nếu một điều tra viên có Thánh tích Cổ đại trên tay, chồng bài, chồng bài bỏ hoặc khu vực chơi bị loại: Ngay lập tức advance sang agenda 3b.
vi_current.flavor: Tại Nexus of N'kai, các kỷ nguyên của Trái Đất vỡ vụn và giao thoa hỗn loạn. Bạn đang đứng giữa ngã tư của quá khứ, hiện tại và tương lai.
vi_current.back_flavor: Không gian xung quanh rạn nứt như kính vỡ, để lộ những thế giới xa lạ bên kia thực tại.

en.name: Pendulous Threads
en.text: Forced - If an investigator with the Relic of Ages in his or her hand, deck, discard pile, or play area is eliminated: Immediately advance to agenda 3b.
en.flavor:
Inside the Nexus, the interwoven
threads of ethereal light
begin to unravel, and reality
unravels with it.
en.back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. If Formless Spawn is in play, place 2 doom on the Nexus of N'kai. If Formless Spawn is in the victory display, shuffle it into the encounter deck. Place this card in the victory display. It gains Vengeance 1.
en.back_flavor: The electrical currents coursing through the machinery of the Nexus begin to malfunction, sending a shower of sparks into the air. The portal ring overheats. Threads of ethereal light within the portal begin to snap.

vi_current.name: Những Sợi Tơ Treo Lơ Lửng
vi_current.text: Forced - Nếu một điều tra viên có Thánh tích Cổ đại trên tay, chồng bài, chồng bài bỏ hoặc khu vực chơi bị loại: Ngay lập tức advance sang agenda 3b.
vi_current.flavor: Thời gian như một con lắc đung đưa giữa sự tồn vong và diệt vong hoàn toàn.
vi_current.back_flavor: Những dòng thời gian bắt đầu triệt tiêu lẫn nhau, xóa sổ hàng triệu năm lịch sử.

en.name: Snapped Threads
en.text: Forced - If an investigator with the Relic of Ages in his or her hand, deck, discard pile, or play area is eliminated: Immediately advance to agenda 3b.
en.flavor: .time shattered of purgatory endless awful this in forever lost is know you Everything .Terrifying .False .different are they but ,repeat on out play future and ,present ,past your from Moments .changed has continuity the ,blink you time Each .between in everything and ,reverse in ,order in out play actions Your .here got you how recall cannot you but ,occurred yet not have that things remember You .alter to continues time of flow The
en.back_flavor:
The timeline collapses.
Reality dissolves before your very eyes. First to vanish is the environment around you: the matter blurs and thins into strings of light that fade into an empty void.
Next comes your body: it disintegrates slowly and painlessly into hundreds of millions of subatomic particles, which diffuse throughout the vast emptiness.
Finally, your cognition: your memories of events both real and unreal. Your hopes and dreams. Thoughts that never held any significance in the infinite scheme of the cosmos.

vi_current.name: Những Sợi Tơ Đứt Vụn
vi_current.text: Forced - Nếu một điều tra viên có Thánh tích Cổ đại trên tay, chồng bài, chồng bài bỏ hoặc khu vực chơi bị loại: Ngay lập tức advance sang agenda 3b.
vi_current.flavor: Vũ trụ chuẩn bị tan biến vào cõi hư vô không tên. Mọi thứ sắp kết thúc!
vi_current.back_name: Hồi Kết Của Mọi Kỷ Nguyên
vi_current.back_text: Mỗi điều tra viên tan biến vào hư không vĩnh hằng. (→R4)
vi_current.back_flavor: Thời gian ngừng trôi. Vũ trụ tan thành cát bụi dưới chân bạn.

en.name: Worlds Beyond
en.text: Forced - When an enemy would spawn at an empty location and there are no empty locations in play: Reveal cards from the exploration deck until a location is revealed. Put that location into play and spawn that enemy there. Shuffle the exploration deck.
en.flavor: The energies of the Nexus swirl in the ground below you, beckoning you to enter. Whether it is a thing of science or magic, you do not know. It is a gateway of sorts, that much you can tell... but a gateway to where?
en.back_text: Shuffle the set-aside A Pocket in Time location into the exploration deck.
en.back_flavor: Each time you step through the Nexus, you get one step closer to your ultimate destination - a place that exists outside the boundaries of time and space...

vi_current.name: Những Thế Giới Bên Kia
vi_current.text: Objective — Thám hiểm các mảnh vỡ thời gian và tìm kiếm Relic of Ages.
vi_current.flavor: Bạn phải băng qua các kỷ nguyên tan vỡ để tìm lại cổ vật định hình thực tại.
vi_current.back_text: Advance sang Act 2 — "Search for the Brotherhood".
vi_current.back_flavor: Bạn phát hiện dấu vết của Alejandro và các tư tế tà giáo đang tiến hành nghi thức tối thượng.

en.name: Search for the Brotherhood
en.text: Objective - If an investigator enters A Pocket in Time, advance.
en.flavor: Somewhere deep within this nexus of worlds lies your objective: a place where timelines converge. You can see it in flashes of insight from beyond this reality. Windows into other timelines. A place carved out of time and space, where the Brotherhood no doubt resides.
en.back_text: Shuffle the set-aside [[Shattered]] locations into the exploration deck. Each investigator shuffles the topmost [[Hex]] treachery in the encounter discard pile into the exploration deck. Check Campaign Log. - If the relic is missing, attach the set-aside Relic of Ages (Unleash the Timestream) to A Pocket in Time, under no investigator's control. Advance to Act 3a - "The Yithian Relic." - If the investigators found the missing relic, advance to Act 3a - "The Yithian Relic."
en.back_flavor: What you see before you is truly staggering. Throughout these halls are hundreds of windows into places both ancient and futuristic: once-grand civilizations that came before even the earliest records of known history, and more still that have yet to be realized. The psychological weight of this discovery is almost more than your mind can bear. Humans are not the masters or caretakers of the Earth. They are merely a footnote in a much longer history - a history which is about to be revised.

vi_current.name: Tìm Kiếm Hội Huynh Đệ
vi_current.text: Objective — Đột kích vị trí của Hội Huynh Đệ và ngăn chặn nghi thức hủy diệt thời gian.
vi_current.flavor: Lũ người rắn đang tập trung toàn bộ năng lượng để viết lại lịch sử nhân loại.
vi_current.back_flavor: Bạn phá vỡ vòng tròn nghi thức và đoạt lấy Relic of Ages đang tỏa sáng chói lòa.

en.name: The Yithian Relic
en.text: [action]: Search your deck or discard pile for the Relic of Ages and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. [action] If the Relic of Ages is attached to your location and there are no clues on that location: Take control of the Relic of Ages. Objective - If an investigator controls the Relic of Ages, advance.
en.flavor: If you intend to mend the shattered timelines, you will need to find the Relic of Ages and learn to harness its power.
en.back_text:
For the remainder of the scenario, if the Relic of Ages leaves play for any reason, shuffle each location attached to it into the exploration deck and reset the act deck to act 3a.
Check Campaign Log. If Ichtaca is set against you:
The thing that was once your companion slithers out of the darkness, hissing. "Yig will have his way! Valusia will be returned to us!"
Spawn the set-aside Ichtaca (Scion of Yig) in the Nexus of N'kai.
If Alejandro is set against you:
"Fools! Are you blind?" Alejandro motions to the worlds before him. "Your kind stands no chance against the ravages of time."
Spawn the set-aside Alejandro (Or, Is He?) in A Pocket in Time.
en.back_flavor: In your hands, you hold the key to fixing all of this. It hums and vibrates with immense power - power that seems to grow and flourish as you visit other timelines.

vi_current.name: Cổ Vật Của Người Yith
vi_current.text: Objective — Kích hoạt Relic of Ages để hàn gắn các dòng thời gian rạn nứt.
vi_current.flavor: Nắm giữ cổ vật trong tay, bạn phải đưa ra quyết định định đoạt số phận của toàn bộ vũ trụ.
vi_current.back_text: Tùy thuộc vào lựa chọn của bạn, advance sang Act 4 tương ứng.
vi_current.back_flavor: Một luồng sáng trắng lóa bao trùm toàn bộ Nexus khi cánh cổng thời gian mở ra.

en.name: Mend the Shatter
en.text: [action] If you are at a [[Shattered]] location with no clues: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, attach your location facedown to the Relic of Ages. Each investigator and enemy at that location is moved to A Pocket in Time. Objective - If the number of locations attached to the Relic of Ages is equal to 1 plus the number of investigators who started the game, advance.
en.flavor: Each window you step through seems to empower the relic. Once the artifact is fully powered, you can use it to mend the shattered timelines and prevent catastrophe.
en.back_text: - If Relic of Ages (Repossess the Past) is the version of the Relic of Ages that the investigators control, proceed to (→R5). - If the investigators control any other version of the Relic of Ages, proceed to (→R1).
en.back_flavor: You manipulate the thrumming device in your hands with the skill and knowledge of one of the relic's ingenious inventors. It is as though your mind has suddenly become flooded with the knowledge of the ancients that came before you. Power seeps from the device's every aperture. Rays of blinding light shoot forth from cracks appearing on its surface. You only have one chance to restore these shattered realities - only one chance to make things right.

vi_current.name: Hàn Gắn Vết Rách (Act 4 - v. I)
vi_current.text: Objective — Dùng sức mạnh của cổ vật để khôi phục lại trật tự tự nhiên của dòng thời gian.
vi_current.flavor: Bạn chọn hàn gắn vết thương của thời gian và đưa mọi thứ trở lại quỹ đạo vốn có.
vi_current.back_flavor: Các mảnh vỡ thời gian từ từ ghép lại hoàn chỉnh. Bạn tỉnh lại giữa rừng mưa nhiệt đới, nơi mọi vết tích siêu nhiên đã lùi vào dĩ vãng.

en.name: Paradise Lost
en.text: [action] If you are at a [[Shattered]] location with no clues: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, attach your location facedown to the Relic of Ages. Each investigator and enemy at that location is moved to A Pocket in Time. Objective - If Valusia is attached to the Relic of Ages, advance.
en.flavor: Each window you step through seems to empower the relic. Once the artifact is fully powered, will you use it to restore the serpent civilization of Valusia to its former glory?
en.back_flavor:
Ichtaca observes you with narrow yellow eyes as you manipulate the thrumming device in your hands. Power seeps from the device's every aperture. Rays of blinding light shoot forth from the cracks appearing on its surface. You watch as the boundary between timelines begins to mend, and the window closes, trapping you within the time and place you have chosen. Once the deed is done, the light fades from the artifact. Its humming ceases, and it never sounds again.
A beautiful yellow sun rises over the lush kingdom of Valusia, and you wonder what to make of your new life.

vi_current.name: Thiên Đường Đã Mất (Act 4 - v. II)
vi_current.text: Objective — Viết lại lịch sử để tạo ra một kỷ nguyên mới tươi đẹp hơn.
vi_current.flavor: Bạn sử dụng quyền năng cổ vật để xóa bỏ mọi đau khổ của quá khứ.
vi_current.back_flavor: Một thế giới mới tươi đẹp hiện ra, nhưng bạn nhận ra cái giá phải trả là sự tha hóa vĩnh viễn của nhân loại.

en.name: Timelock
en.text: [action] If you are at a [[Shattered]] location with no clues: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, attach your location facedown to the Relic of Ages. Each investigator and enemy at that location is moved to A Pocket in Time. Objective - If Pnakotus is attached to the Relic of Ages, advance.
en.flavor: Each window you step through seems to empower the relic. Once the artifact is fully powered, will you use it to prevent the destruction of Pnakotus and the Yithians?
en.back_flavor:
Alejandro studies your every move as you manipulate the thrumming device in your hands. Power seeps from the device's every aperture. Rays of blinding light shoot forth from the cracks appearing on its surface. You watch as the boundary between timelines begins to mend, and the window closes, trapping you within the time and place you have chosen. Once the deed is done, the light fades from the artifact. Its humming ceases, and it never sounds again.
"Come, my friend," Alejandro says stoically, motioning toward the tallest basalt tower of the city of endless archives. "Now our work can truly begin."

vi_current.name: Khóa Thời Gian (Act 4 - v. III)
vi_current.text: Objective — Đóng băng vĩnh viễn dòng thời gian để ngăn chặn sự diệt vong.
vi_current.flavor: Bạn chọn đóng băng khoảnh khắc này mãi mãi.
vi_current.back_flavor: Mọi chuyển động dừng lại. Vũ trụ chìm vào một bức tranh tĩnh lặng vĩnh cửu.

en.name: Into the Ruins Once Again
en.text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.
en.flavor: Despite everything that has occurred since you were last here, the Eztli temple remains the same as it was when you first explored it, preserved in an echo of time. You use your memories to guide you, heading deeper into the ruins once more.
en.back_text: Shuffle the set-aside Chamber of Time location into the exploration deck. Place this act in the victory display. It gains Vengeance 2.
en.back_flavor: You pass by carvings in the walls and hieroglyphs etched into stone altars. The location of the relic's vault is already locked deep in your memory.

vi_current.name: Tiến Vào Tàn Tích Một Lần Nữa
vi_current.text: [action]: Explore. Rút lá bài trên cùng của chồng bài khám phá. Nếu đó là địa điểm đang kết nối, hãy đặt nó vào màn chơi và di chuyển đến đó.
vi_current.flavor: Được trao cơ hội quay ngược thời gian, bạn trở lại tàn tích Eztli với toàn bộ tri thức của tương lai.
vi_current.back_name: Căn Phòng Của Những Tàn Tích
vi_current.back_flavor: Bạn tiến thẳng vào phòng tế lễ mà không vướng phải những cạm bẫy chết người.

en.name: The Chamber of Still Remains
en.text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Objective - Only investigators in the Chamber of Time may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
en.flavor: In the central chamber deep within the core of the ruins, the relic awaits.
en.back_text: Choose an investigator in the Chamber of Time to take control of the Relic of Ages. Search the collection for Yig (The Forgotten Age card #296). Spawn it in the Chamber of Time. Place this act in the victory display. It gains Vengeance 2.
en.back_flavor: The relic hums with power and throbs in your hands. Energy from the device seeps into the corridors of the ruins, and the structure of the temple shifts. However, this does not matter to you. Escaping with the relic is no longer your goal. You skillfully work the hidden components of the device once more, manipulating the very fabric of time in the environment around you. Determined to stop all of this from having ever occurred, you turn the clock back once more.

vi_current.name: Căn Phòng Của Những Tàn Tích Còn Lại
vi_current.text: [action]: Explore. Rút lá bài trên cùng của chồng bài khám phá. Nếu đó là địa điểm đang kết nối, hãy đặt nó vào màn chơi và di chuyển đến nó. Objective - Chỉ các điều tra viên trong Phòng thời gian mới có thể dành số lượng manh mối cần thiết, với tư cách là một nhóm, cho advance.
vi_current.flavor: Harbinger of Valusia đang đứng đợi bạn, nhưng lần này bạn đã sẵn sàng.
vi_current.back_flavor: Bạn giáng đòn quyết định hạ gục kẻ gác đền nghìn năm.

en.name: Moment of Doom
en.text: Relic of Ages gains: "[action]: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (4). If you succeed, flip a clue controlled by an investigator at your location to its doom side, and place it on your location. Then, deal 3 damage to Yig." Objective - If Yig is defeated, advance.
en.flavor: You stand in the center of the relic’s vault, surrounded on all sides by slain Eztli warriors. The Father of Serpents stands before you, his hiss shaking you to your bones. This is where the Eztli made their last stand. Now, only you stand in the creature’s way.
en.back_flavor: The creature roars in pain. His tail thrashes violently, crushing several pillars and sending you flying to the ground. He retreats with a hateful, rumbling hiss. You turn your attention back to the relic and the chamber that was built to preserve it. It is time to end this, once and for all. It is time to do what must be done.

vi_current.name: Khoảnh Khắc Của Doom
vi_current.text: Objective — Phong ấn vĩnh viễn Relic of Ages và phá hủy ngôi đền Eztli. [action]: Advance.
vi_current.flavor: Đây là cơ hội cuối cùng để sửa chữa mọi sai lầm của lịch sử!
vi_current.back_flavor: Ngôi đền sụp đổ hoàn toàn, chôn vùi vĩnh viễn cổ vật thời gian dưới lòng đất sâu. Bạn đã cứu rỗi tương lai của nhân loại!

en.name: Search for the Meaning
en.text: Objective - Only investigators in Rivertown can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
en.flavor: You decide to head to the estate of Marshall Hastings to learn more about the strange happenings mentioned in the Advertiser's article. Perhaps this new development can shed light on your other recent troubles.

vi_current.name: Tìm Kiếm Ý Nghĩa
vi_current.text: Objective - Chỉ các điều tra viên ở Rivertown mới có thể dành số lượng manh mối cần thiết, với tư cách là một nhóm, cho advance.
vi_current.flavor: Những điềm báo thời gian ngày càng trở nên rõ nét.

en.name: Search for the Source
en.text: Objective - Only investigators in Northside can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
en.flavor: In order to get to the bottom of this new development, you decide to search for the anonymous source of the Advertiser's article. Perhaps if you head to its offices in Northside, you can inquire further - although you may have to grease a few palms to get the information you need.

vi_current.name: Tìm Kiếm Cội Nguồn
vi_current.text: Objective - Chỉ các điều tra viên ở Northside mới có thể dành số lượng manh mối cần thiết, với tư cách là một nhóm, cho advance.
vi_current.flavor: Dấu vết dẫn thẳng tới dinh thự cổ ngoại ô.

en.name: The Overgrown Estate
en.text: Objective - Only investigators at The Hastings Estate can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
en.flavor: When you arrive at the Hastings estate, you find it in a much sorrier state than was originally described. The rainforest has come to Arkham, claiming the manor and the surrounding area almost entirely.
en.back_text: Search the collection for the Harbinger of Valusia (The Sleeper Returns) and spawn it at The Hastings Estate. It enters play with damage on it equal to the amount of damage recorded in parentheses in your Campaign Log. If there are 5 or fewer tally marks under "Yig's Fury" in your Campaign Log, it enters play exhausted. Advance to Act 3g - "Impossible Pursuit".
en.back_flavor: You scour the estate for clues but find nothing that wasn't already described in the Advertiser's article. It's like your fears have come to life: the rainforest has indeed followed you all the way here to Arkham. After dreading this for so long, it's almost a relief to finally be able to confront it. Just then, a familiar rattling echoes through the halls of the manor. The dreadful sound makes your skin crawl. Surely, it couldn't be... could it?

vi_current.name: Dinh Thự U Uất
vi_current.text: Objective - Chỉ các điều tra viên tại The Hastings Estate mới có thể dành số lượng manh mối cần thiết, với tư cách là một nhóm, cho advance.
vi_current.flavor: Cỏ dại và dây leo bao phủ khắp khu biệt thự hoang tàn.
vi_current.back_text: Search the collection for the Harbinger of Valusia (The Sleeper Returns) and spawn it at The Hastings Estate. It enters play with damage on it equal to the amount of damage recorded in parentheses in your Campaign Log. If there are 5 or fewer tally marks under "Yig's Fury" in your Campaign Log, it enters play exhausted. Advance to Act 3g - "Impossible Pursuit".
vi_current.back_flavor: Bạn lùng sục khu đất để tìm manh mối nhưng không tìm thấy gì chưa được mô tả trong bài viết của Advertiser. Giống như nỗi sợ hãi của bạn đã trở thành hiện thực: rừng nhiệt đới thực sự đã theo bạn đến tận Arkham. Sau khi lo sợ điều này quá lâu, thật nhẹ nhõm khi cuối cùng cũng có thể đối mặt với nó. Ngay sau đó, một tiếng lạch cạch quen thuộc vang vọng khắp các sảnh của trang viên. Âm thanh khủng khiếp khiến bạn nổi da gà. Chắc chắn là không thể nào... phải không?

en.name: The Overgrown Estate
en.text: Objective - Only investigators at The Hastings Estate can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
en.flavor: When you arrive at the Hastings estate, you find it in a much sorrier state than was originally described. The rainforest has come to Arkham, claiming the manor and the surrounding area almost entirely.

vi_current.name: Dinh Thự U Uất
vi_current.text: Objective - Chỉ các điều tra viên tại The Hastings Estate mới có thể dành số lượng manh mối cần thiết, với tư cách là một nhóm, cho advance.
vi_current.flavor: Những cái bẫy chết người được giăng sẵn đón khách không mời.

en.name: Seeking Trouble
en.text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Merle Garvin: You must remove them and immediately advance.
en.flavor: You've learned the identity of the Advertiser's source: a man named Merle Garvin, who recently returned from an expedition funded by none other than Marshall Hastings. He was last seen anxiously rummaging through the library at the university, though nobody is quite sure why.
en.back_text: Search the collection for the Harbinger of Valusia (The Sleeper Returns) and spawn it at Merle Garvin's location. It enters play with damage on it equal to the amount of damage recorded in parentheses in your Campaign Log. If there are 5 or fewer tally marks under "Yig's Fury" in your Campaign Log, it enters play exhausted. Advance to Act 3g - "Impossible Pursuit".
en.back_flavor: When you finally track Mr. Garvin down and corner him, he is absolutely terrified - not of you, but of something else entirely. "It's coming," he warns. "It won't ever stop until all of us are dead. Please, you have to help me! You have to hide me!" Before you can ask what it is that frightens him so, your unspoken question is answered by a familiar rattling. The dreadful sound makes your skin crawl. How could it be here in Arkham?

vi_current.name: Tìm Kiếm Rắc Rối
vi_current.text: Objective - Nếu có 1 [per_investigator] manh mối trên Merle Garvin: Bạn phải loại bỏ chúng và ngay lập tức advance.
vi_current.flavor: Những kẻ thù quen thuộc xuất hiện ở mọi khúc quanh.
vi_current.back_text: Search the collection for the Harbinger of Valusia (The Sleeper Returns) and spawn it at Merle Garvin's location. It enters play with damage on it equal to the amount of damage recorded in parentheses in your Campaign Log. If there are 5 or fewer tally marks under "Yig's Fury" in your Campaign Log, it enters play exhausted. Advance to Act 3g - "Impossible Pursuit".
vi_current.back_flavor: Cuối cùng khi bạn lần ra ông Garvin và dồn ông ta vào chân tường, ông ta thực sự sợ hãi - không phải vì bạn mà vì một điều gì đó hoàn toàn khác. “Nó đang đến,” anh cảnh báo. "Nó sẽ không bao giờ dừng lại cho đến khi tất cả chúng ta đều chết. Làm ơn, bạn phải giúp tôi! Bạn phải giấu tôi đi!" Trước khi bạn có thể hỏi điều gì đã khiến anh ấy sợ hãi đến thế, câu hỏi ngầm của bạn đã được trả lời bằng một tiếng lạch cạch quen thuộc. Âm thanh khủng khiếp khiến bạn nổi da gà. Làm sao it có thể ở đây trong Arkham?

en.name: Seeking Trouble
en.text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Merle Garvin: You must remove them and immediately advance.
en.flavor: You've learned the identity of the Advertiser's source: a man named Merle Garvin, who recently returned from an expedition funded by none other than Marshall Hastings. He was last seen anxiously rummaging through the library at the university, though nobody is quite sure why.

vi_current.name: Tìm Kiếm Rắc Rối
vi_current.text: Objective - Nếu có 1 [per_investigator] manh mối trên Merle Garvin: Bạn phải loại bỏ chúng và ngay lập tức advance.
vi_current.flavor: Đám giáo đồ ráo riết săn lùng dấu vết của bạn.

en.name: Discover the Truth
en.text: Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Clinton Freeman: You must remove them and immediately advance. Objective - If Loading Docks is in play and there are no clues remaining on it: You must immediately advance.
en.flavor: You're close to learning the truth behind this other expedition. What were they after, and why? Does this have anything to do with Ichtaca and the Eztli?
en.back_text:
If Clinton Freeman is in play:
Mr. Freeman finally reveals to you the truth: that his expedition was partially funded by a mysterious "philanthropist" in Mexico City, in return for several relics. Curious - and worried - he and his partners offer to help you get to the bottom of this.
The investigator nearest to Clinton Freeman takes control of the set-aside Veda Whitsley. Remove the remainder of the "g/h" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
If Loading Docks is in play:
Thanks to Mr. Garvin's information, you discover that many of the expedition's finds are heading to a surprising destination: an unspecified recipient in Mexico City. Grateful for your assistance, several members of the expedition offer you their help.
The investigator nearest to the Loading Docks takes control of the set-aside Veda Whitsley. Remove the remainder of the "g/h" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).

vi_current.name: Khám Phá Sự Thật
vi_current.text: Objective - Nếu có 1 [per_investigator] manh mối trên Clinton Freeman: Bạn phải loại bỏ chúng và ngay lập tức advance. Objective - Nếu Loading Docks là trong màn chơi và không còn manh mối trên đó: Bạn phải ngay lập tức advance.
vi_current.flavor: Bức tranh toàn cảnh về âm mưu nghìn năm dần hé lộ.
vi_current.back_text:
If Clinton Freeman is trong màn chơi:
Mr. Freeman finally reveals to you the truth: that his expedition was partially funded by a mysterious "philanthropist" in Mexico City, in return for several relics. Curious - and worried - he and his partners offer to help you get to the bottom of this.

If Loading Docks is trong màn chơi:
Thanks to Mr. Garvin's information, you discover that many of the expedition's finds are heading to a surprising destination: an unspecified recipient in Mexico City. Grateful for your assistance, several members of the expedition offer you their help.
The investigator nearest to the Loading Docks takes control of the set-aside Veda Whitsley. Remove the remainder of the "g/h" act deck from the game. If another act card is trong màn chơi, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).

en.name: Impossible Pursuit
en.text: Objective - If the Harbinger of Valusia leaves play, advance.
en.flavor: You never thought this creature would track you all the way to Arkham. Or perhaps it's just a figment of your imagination. A ghost in your mind. A shard of your subconscious, driving you away from this line of inquiry.
en.back_text: The investigator nearest to the Harbinger of Valusia takes control of the set-aside Veda Whitsley. Remove the remainder of the "g/h" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
en.back_flavor: As quickly as it arrived, the serpent-thing is gone. You're still not sure if it was really there to begin with, but for the moment, it seems you are safe. Grateful for your assistance, several members of the other expedition offer you their help. Whether or not there was a link to the Eztli in the relics they found remains to be seen. Regardless, their expertise will surely be invaluable if creatures like this one continue to haunt your every step.

vi_current.name: Cuộc Truy Đuổi Bất Khả Thi
vi_current.text: Objective - Nếu điềm báo Valusia rời khỏi cuộc chơi, advance.
vi_current.flavor: Chạy đua với chính dòng chảy của thời gian.
vi_current.back_text: The investigator nearest to the Harbinger of Valusia takes control of the set-aside Veda Whitsley. Remove the remainder of the "g/h" act deck from the game. If another act card is trong màn chơi, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
vi_current.back_flavor: Ngay khi nó đến, con rắn đã biến mất. Bạn vẫn không chắc liệu nó có thực sự ở đó ngay từ đầu hay không, nhưng hiện tại, có vẻ như bạn vẫn an toàn. Biết ơn sự giúp đỡ của bạn, một số thành viên của đoàn thám hiểm khác đề nghị giúp đỡ bạn. Liệu có mối liên hệ nào với Eztli trong di tích mà họ tìm thấy hay không thì vẫn còn phải xem. Dù thế nào đi nữa, chuyên môn của họ chắc chắn sẽ là vô giá nếu những sinh vật như thế này tiếp tục ám ảnh từng bước đi của bạn.

en.name: A Familiar Pattern
en.text: Objective - When the investigators have collected the requisite number of clues, they must immediately spend them and advance.
en.flavor: Six stone pillars surround the entrance to the cavern, each carved with a series of uncanny grooves and hieroglyphs that form an intricate pattern. Touching them causes the grooves to glow brightly, and twisting them causes the patterns to shift and change. Perhaps these patterns match the glyphs found in other regions of the rainforest?

vi_current.name: Một Hoa Văn Quen Thuộc
vi_current.text: Objective - Khi các điều tra viên đã thu thập đủ số lượng manh mối cần thiết, họ phải tiêu ngay số tiền đó và advance.
vi_current.flavor: Những biểu tượng trên cột đá dường như trùng khớp với ghi chép của Alejandro.

scenario: Return to the City of Archives

en.name: Unrestricted Access
en.text: Objective - If three of the following are true, you must advance: - An investigator "found the process." - An investigator "dissected an organ." - An investigator "interviewed a subject." - An investigator "realized what year it is." - An investigator "activated the device." - An investigator controls The Custodian. - An investigator "read about Earth." - An investigator "saw a familiar specimen."
en.back_text: You no longer have to perform any of the following tasks. However, the more you have performed by the time the scenario ends, the easier the transition to your human body will be, and the less likely the process is to fail or backfire. Be careful... Put this act into play with this side faceup as a reminder. - An investigator "found the process." - An investigator "dissected an organ." - An investigator "interviewed a subject." - An investigator "realized what year it is." - An investigator "activated the device." - An investigator controls The Custodian. - An investigator "read about Earth." - An investigator "saw a familiar specimen."
en.back_flavor: The truth is hard to accept. Your body was never brought to this place. Your mind has been transferred into the body of one of these creatures. Somewhere, in another place - in another time - one of the reviled creatures dwells in your body.

vi_current.name: Tiếp Cận Không Hạn Chế
vi_current.text: Objective — Dùng chìa khóa mã hóa để mở toang kho lưu trữ tâm trí.
vi_current.flavor: Hệ thống máy tính cổ xưa nhấp nháy ánh sáng cho phép bạn truy cập dữ liệu tối mật.
vi_current.back_flavor: Bạn tìm thấy ống chứa lưu trữ mẫu sóng não của mình!
